mapper.select: SELECT rank_id, rank_name, rank_icon, min_score, max_score, color, description, sort_order FROM my_rank_config WHERE min_score <= #{score} AND max_score >= #{score} LIMIT 1
SELECT rank_id, rank_name, rank_icon, min_score, max_score, color, description, sort_order FROM my_rank_config WHERE min_score > #{score} ORDER BY min_score ASC LIMIT 1
